What can a room full of AI builders make in five hours?

The Gen Academy, Mem0, and Sillion Valley AI Hub are hosting the /build-with-AI Buildathon during SF Tech Week. 

Building together makes the conversation about AI much more useful. Once you’re trying to make something work, you have specific things to discuss: why you chose that approach, where it breaks, and what you’d change.

If you’d like to spend an evening building, come join us.

October 5 · SVAI Hub, Menlo Park, CA

Just got accepted into Y Combinator Startup School 2026 🇺🇸 
Heading to San Francisco this July.

Excited to meet cracked founders and maybe get a photo with Jensen Huang (plus grab those $25k compute credits).

The Founders Who Build Iconic Companies Start With Ideas Everyone Else Dismisses Alexandr Wang, the founder of Scale AI and now Chief AI Officer at Meta, shared a simple but powerful truth at Y Combinator's Startup School 2026 . If your idea already has broad agreement, someone has likely already built it, or the opportunity has passed . The best founders start with ideas that seem strange, small, or even wrong to most people because that is where the real leverage lives.

Tech entrepreneur Sabeer Bhatia has sparked reactions on social media with a pointed remark on the Indian rupee’s decline against the US dollar. In a post, Bhatia wrote that if the rupee touches ₹100 against the dollar, people should “get your pots and pans ready” — an apparent reference to symbolic public mobilisation campaigns seen during past national crises. The comment comes amid renewed debate over currency pressures and economic management.

Things that have concerned me this week as a Software Engineer 

1. Me forgetting the syntax of various languages like Java, Python, and Angular without the assistance of AI Coding Assistants like Claude Code and Copilot, and the fear that I may eventually lose the ability to write code independently.
2. Whenever there is an error/bug that I ask the agent to resolve, I jump to the solution instead of understanding what actually caused it, which means I’m loosing my ability to learn from my work.
